title: Tamil Nadu Allocates ₹44,527 Crore for School Education

blocks.content: Tamil Nadu allocated ₹44,527 crore to the School Education Department in its maiden budget for the financial year 2026-27. Finance Minister N. Marie Wilson presented the budget on 5 August 2026, and the allocation placed school education among the largest spending heads in the state budget.

items: Tamil Nadu is one of India’s major states by population and has a large network of government and aided schools.
State budgets in India are presented annually under the Constitution of India through the Finance Minister.
School education is a State List subject under the Seventh Schedule of the Constitution of India.
Budget allocations for education often include infrastructure, staffing, and student support components.
